baseline_models.focus_anchor: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ... نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A benefaction is marked by its source, recognized by its recipient, and answered by fitting recompense; provenance, reception, and return form one reciprocal circuit.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction and improved condition supply the good that enters the reciprocal circuit.
Near presence fixes the benefaction's provenance rather than leaving it an anonymous good.
Act-for-act recompense makes the second clause answer the first.
Recognition and manifested praise supply the recipient response that closes the circuit.

changed_reading.before: A favor is given, followed by a general maxim that grateful people are rewarded.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents provenance-aware reciprocity: a benefit from the divine presence is recognized by its recipient and answered with fitting recompense.

baseline_models.mechanism: The increase branch of benefaction and the small-input, visible-effect branch of gratitude make gratefulness a high-gain response: received good becomes productive in the receiver and invites renewed increase.

activation_trace.role: Increase and intensification give the initial benefaction an expandable vector.
A little input producing a visible effect models gratitude as responsive uptake rather than mere speech.
Recompense returns increase to the recipient's productive response.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is verbal thanks for an already completed gift.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is receptivity that makes even a small gift visibly productive, while recompense renews the increase rather than adding a detached prize.

baseline_models.mechanism: The substitution branch of recompense allows the sourced benefaction itself to stand in for and suffice on behalf of the grateful recipient; gift and reward need not be separate objects.

activation_trace.role: The benefaction supplies the concrete good that can itself function as recompense.
Standing in for another and sufficing makes recompense protective substitution rather than only added payment.
Recognition identifies the recipient for whom the sourced good suffices.

changed_reading.before: Reward is an extra item delivered after gratitude.
changed_reading.after: The favor can itself be the recompense: a provision from the giver that stands in for, covers, and suffices for the grateful person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warnings and manifest signs invite recognition; denial contradicts them and kufr can cover a benefaction. This makes شكر the active opposite: receiving, acknowledging, and showing the sourced favor, with recompense following that disclosed stance.

activation_trace.role: The benefaction is the object that can either be recognized and shown or covered.
Recognition and manifestation define the positive response to the disclosed good.
Contradiction of truth supplies the first negative mirror of grateful recognition.
Warning that awakens caution supplies content meant to be received rather than disputed.
The manifest sign makes recognition an evidential response, not only an affective one.
Covering a benefaction directly reverses the focus branch's recognition and manifestation.

structural_cues: Denial recurs around warnings and all the signs, while 54:35 uses the inferential كَذَٰلِكَ and the generalizing مَن.
The later label كُفَّارُ supplies a branch-level polarity with the focus pair نِعْمَةً and شَكَرَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warnings, manifest signs, denial, and the covering-of-benefaction branch; I infer that recognition versus concealment is the response axis carried into كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى. A live alternative is that شكر remains ordinary thanks after rescue and the epistemic polarity is only contextual.

changed_reading.before: Whoever feels or voices thanks receives a reward.
changed_reading.after: Whoever refuses to cover what has been disclosed, recognizes its source, and lets the benefaction become manifest is met with the corresponding recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from a named people to a collective boast of gathered victory and then to a broken line turning its back. Against that sequence, مَن شَكَرَ states a portable response criterion that group identity and cohesion cannot replace.

activation_trace.role: Recognition supplies the qualifying response attached to the unrestricted مَن.
Recompense follows the response criterion rather than collective standing.
A people as a social collective supplies the identity scale that the focus criterion cuts across.
Gathering dispersed members into one body supplies the claimed mechanism of collective security.
Aid and manifested victory state what the gathered group expects from itself.
Breaking and driving back a battle line reverses the group's claimed cohesion.
Turning the back completes the reversal from self-declared victory to retreat.

structural_cues: The generic construction مَن شَكَرَ contrasts with the plural boast نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ.
54:45 immediately answers gathered victory with defeat and turned backs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective labels, a group boast, and its military reversal; I infer that the singularly predicated response in مَن شَكَرَ is deliberately non-corporate. A live alternative is that مَن is merely generic grammar with no contrastive force.

changed_reading.before: The maxim promises reward without specifying how it relates to social identity.
changed_reading.after: Recompense tracks anyone's enacted recognition, while inherited peoplehood, numerical cohesion, and claimed mutual victory provide no substitute criterion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A household is separated from a pelting destructive field. The focus benefaction therefore becomes an outcome-changing extraction, and the sufficiency branch of جزاء lets that rescue stand in place of the fate otherwise surrounding the recipients.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction names the good condition produced by removal from the destructive field.
Protective sufficiency allows the rescue itself to replace the threatened outcome as recompense.
A stone-driving wind supplies the encompassing destructive field from which removal matters.
The household as those who return to one another defines the social unit extracted.
Deliverance by separation supplies the spatial operation that turns favor into rescue.

structural_cues: The exception إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ and نَجَّيْنَٰهُم immediately precede the accusative نِعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a pelting agent, an excepted household, and deliverance by separation; I infer that نِعْمَةً names the selective extraction and that نجزي generalizes its logic. A live alternative is that نِعْمَةً is only a causal gloss on rescue without a substitution mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The favor is an unspecified positive gift.
changed_reading.after: The favor is a selective change of outcome: the grateful recipient is separated out, and rescue itself suffices as the recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pre-dawn rescue and morning punishment occupy one temporal threshold but produce opposite settled outcomes. The focus maxim becomes the hinge naming a timed differentiation rather than an indefinitely deferred reward.

activation_trace.role: Fitting recompense links the two opposed outcomes at the shared temporal threshold.
The last part of night locates rescue just before the threshold turns.
Arrival in the morning supplies the matching time of the contrary outcome.
Early morning sharpens the temporal correspondence with pre-dawn rescue.
Fixity and settlement make the morning outcome durable rather than momentary.

structural_cues: 54:35 stands between rescue بِسَحَرٍ and punishment that arrives بُكْرَةً as مُسْتَقِرّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pre-dawn rescue, morning arrival, and settled punishment; I infer that their near-parallel timing makes 54:35 a threshold-sorting rule. A live alternative is that the times only mark narrative chronology and do not modify نجزي.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a general future consequence with no temporal texture.
changed_reading.after: Recompense appears as precisely timed sorting at a threshold: one party is removed before dawn while the contrary outcome arrives and settles in the morning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disputed warning is followed by erased sight and compelled tasting. This turns gratitude into an open perception-to-recognition response, while recompense mirrors refusal to acknowledge by converting a contested disclosure into unavoidable embodied experience.

activation_trace.role: Recognition and bodily manifestation supply the voluntary perception-to-response circuit.
Recompense supplies the return path from epistemic stance to experienced outcome.
Contentious denial of truth supplies the blocked recognition that initiates the reversal.
Loss of light and sight turns failed recognition into a matched sensory deprivation.
The seeing eye identifies the faculty on which the reciprocal reversal lands.
Experiential tasting converts what was disputed into inescapable firsthand knowledge.

structural_cues: 54:36 places disputation before 54:37's sequence of effaced eyes and the imperative to taste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, loss of sight, and experiential tasting; I infer a reciprocal arrow from refused recognition to coerced embodiment, with شكر naming the intact voluntary alternative. A live alternative is that these are punitive details without a specific relation to gratitude.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is primarily a verbal or emotional response to favor.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is the intact conversion of perception into acknowledgment; when that circuit is refused, recompense can force the denied reality back through bodily experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease lowers the threshold of reception and reminder places a recoverable cue before the hearer. Together they strengthen the focus branch in which a slight input produces a visible effect: gratitude is successful uptake of made-accessible disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Increase makes the benefaction capable of continuing through the recipient's response.
A small provision with a visible effect supplies the high-gain uptake model.
Opening into ease after difficulty lowers the reception threshold.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the minimal cue offered for uptake.

structural_cues: 54:40 repeats the paired claim and question: the Qur'an is made easy for remembrance, then a remembering respondent is sought.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies easing, a reminder, and a requested rememberer; I infer that this is a reception test parallel to مَن شَكَرَ and that the small-input branch explains its gain. A live alternative is that remembrance and gratitude are adjacent but separate responses.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude responds to a large, unmistakable benefit after it has arrived.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude is high-gain uptake: an accessible cue is retained and made visibly fruitful, so the received favor continues as increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accountability-taking, measured governance, discharge of a claim, and written records activate the debt-settlement branch of جزاء. The favor is no longer merely discretionary largesse; it is the positive settlement of a provenance that the grateful recipient acknowledges.

activation_trace.role: Collection and satisfaction of a debt supply the account-settlement form of recompense.
Acknowledgment of benefaction supplies the recipient's recognition of provenance within the account.
Being taken to account for fault supplies the enforcement side of settlement.
Deliberate measured governance makes the settlement calibrated rather than arbitrary.
Discharge of a right or claim supplies the legal possibility that the challenge denies.
Writing and books make claimed exemption inspectable rather than self-declared.

structural_cues: 54:42 doubles أَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ before 54:43 asks whether there is بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enforced taking, measured power, discharge, and records; I infer that these form a juridical account around the focus's debt branch of جزاء. A live alternative is that the later exemption question only rebuts confidence and does not juridically color the earlier favor.

changed_reading.before: Reward is an unstructured act of generosity following thanks.
changed_reading.after: Recompense is a legible, calibrated settlement: the grateful acknowledge the benefit's source and receive the positive side of an account that no group can cancel by asserting an unrecorded exemption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps guest custody onto the source-marked favor. It remains valid as a relational analogy anchored in عِندِنَا, the attempted diversion, and the guest's arrival; downstream prose must not claim that the favor literally is the guest or that the analogy exhausts شكر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِّنْ عِندِنَا marks origin and nearness, while شَكَرَ marks faithful recognition of the giver.

activation_trace.role: Near presence gives the benefaction a relational origin that the recipient must preserve.
Recognition of the benefactor supplies fidelity to the good's provenance.
Solicitation toward an act supplies pressure to divert what is under relational protection.
One who inclines and descends as a guest supplies the received arrival whose relation is contested.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is enjoyment plus acknowledgment of a possessed gift.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, gratitude is faithful custody of what arrives from another's near presence, and recompense mirrors the recipient's refusal to sever the gift from its source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the form-distant mapped ج ز ز branch and cross-domain growth imagery. It remains packet-anchored in نَجْزِى, the new-shoot branch of شكر, increase, first-fruit timing, and yield; downstream prose must label it a material analogy, never an etymology or translation of the focus wording.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَجْزِى is held to its split mapped inventory, while نِعْمَةً and شَكَرَ supply increase and visible growth.

activation_trace.role: Ripeness at cutting or harvest time supplies a contained material image for when recompense becomes yield.
Fresh shoots make the recipient's response visible as new growth.
Increase supplies the growth vector from benefaction toward yield.
Firstness and first fruit sharpen the image of a response reaching visible maturity.
Growth and yield reinforce the analogy of received provision becoming productive surplus.

changed_reading.before: Reward is an abstract payment attached to gratitude.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recompense is harvest: benefaction increases, gratitude appears as fresh growth, and the matured response is gathered as yield.

strongest_changes: Gratitude became the epistemic and visible opposite of denying signs and covering a benefaction.
The storm-exception-rescue sequence recast favor as selective extraction and protective substitution.
Ease and reminder reframed gratitude as high-gain uptake in which a small accessible cue becomes visibly productive.
Collective boasting and defeat made مَن شَكَرَ a response criterion that group identity and cohesion cannot replace.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's own branches form a provenance-reception-return circuit; the context then changes that circuit spatially, temporally, epistemically, socially, sensorially, and juridically without forcing the readings into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The pre-dawn and morning parallel may be only narrative chronology rather than a semantic timing mechanism.
The guest-provenance model is a relational analogy whose directional link remains exploratory.
The ج ز ي to ج ز ز harvest model and other material-yield images must remain explicitly analogical.
